## Problem / Use Case
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe clearly (e.g. "I want to deploy model X on AMD GPU Y with runtime Z").

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution or enhancement you would like to see implemented.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions, tools, or workarounds you have considered.

## Hardware & Environment Scope
- Which AMD GPU architectures does this target? (e.g. RDNA 3 gfx1100, CDNA 3 gfx942, or CPU fallback)
- Does this require specific ROCm or PyTorch versions?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, references, or links here.
